_doc: Corsair line skill definitions (spec #384, ticket C2 #386). Each skill ticket appends its own region of `skills` (separate tickets, separate regions): C3 Dash's mobility rank rule (Dash stays in skills/pirate.json); C4 Double Shot, Invisible Shot, Recoil Shot and Grenade (moved from pirate.json, with Burst Fire); C5-C13 the rest of the pool (Flamethrower, Ice Splitter, Octopus, Gaviota, Homing Beacon, Aerial Strike, Rapid Fire, Battleship and its sub-skills). A pool key with no entry here stays inert: it is never offered, learned or cast. A key may be defined in one file only (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md 4.4.4). Books may be 500, 520, 521 or 522. C2 defined none.

homing_beacon.name: Homing Beacon
homing_beacon.desc: Sends the parrot after the nearest monster and marks it: every hit on it deals more damage and your shots prefer it.
homing_beacon._tier: Tier A (WZ 5211006, book 521): damage 148..380% by level (172 / 260 / 380% at rank 1 / 4 / 8, levels 4 / 15 / 30), range 350, no time and no x (the mark's length is not in the WZ), the 4-frame parrot ball, the 6-frame effect, hit/0, the 5-frame mob loop (the mark art), the homing stance and the Use / Hit sounds. Tier C (spec #384 C8 #392, GAME_DESIGN 7.120.4): auto-cast nearest, 10 s cooldown, 500 px/s, 10 px radius, one target, no pierce, 0.6 s stance hold, the 8 s mark (x1.5, x1.25 on a boss, MobSwarm ALL_WEAK) and the rarity bonuses. Untuned.
